description: Bounded 72-identifier functional evidence ledger: 6 previously proven environments plus 16 B2 pretextual/summary commands; not global i18n or normative certification
validation_policy: PASS requires independently inspected real PDF artifact tied to the original code SHA and unchanged LaTeX class blob. PENDING includes identifiers with only source or test fixture links. NA is permitted only with explicit positive rationale. PASS here is bounded scenario evidence, not full surface acceptance.

core-lists-12.qualification: Proof of generated labels, content and placement in bounded synthetic PDFs; human normative and linguistic acceptance pending.

optional-env-12.qualification: Proof of isolated optional environment PDF body, captions, source labels and language; human normative and linguistic acceptance pending.

b2-family-12.qualification: 12 bounded public-command scenarios across original integrated and pretextual PDFs, PDF physical pages and SHA256 authenticated from original ZIPs; human normative and linguistic review pending.

b2-summary-remaining.qualification: 10 actual PDFs: 4 locale-direct summaries, 4 legacy PT/EN pairs, 2 optional English ES/FR; PT/EN optional is locale-inapplicable; human normative and linguistic review pending.
